resources.string: The map for this route is not on your phone. Atlas can send your start and destination to the FOSSGIS routing server and get the route from there.
The route server did not answer.
Try again in a moment, or download the map for this area to route without a connection.
When the map for a route is not on your phone, get the route from a route server.
The address of a Valhalla server of your own, starting with https://. Leave it empty to use the FOSSGIS server.
The map for this area is not on your phone. Atlas can get the part you are looking at from the OpenFreeMap map server, piece by piece as you move. The server sees which area you look at.
Where no map is on your phone, show the map from a map server as you look at it.
On mobile data, show only the parts of the map already seen.
The address of a map tile server of your own (OpenMapTiles layout), starting with https://. Leave it empty to use OpenFreeMap.
The map shown online: OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles. Data from OpenStreetMap.
Looking for your position: %1$d satellites seen, %2$d in use

The phone has not found where it is yet. A first fix can take several minutes, longest indoors, and after the phone was off for a while or has traveled far. It helps to stand under open sky and keep still. If the phone\'s location settings offer A-GPS (assisted GPS), switching it on makes the first fix much faster while the phone has a connection; on the Kompakt it is off until you switch it on.
Satellites seen: %1$d, in use: %2$d (a fix needs at least four in use).
The last position is less than a minute old.
The last position is %1$d minutes old.
The last position is %1$d hours old.

Atlas can send the address you typed to an address server and show where it is: the geocoder of the US Census Bureau for an address in the United States, Photon (run by Komoot, from OpenStreetMap data) anywhere else. The server sees the address and your internet address. Nothing is sent while you type.
The address server found nothing for this address.
The address server did not answer. Is the phone online?
Search offers to look an address up on an address server.
The address of a Photon server of your own, ending in /api and starting with https://. Leave it empty to use the US Census geocoder in the United States and Photon elsewhere.
